messages:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT: High GPU queue growth in us-west1 detected by autoscaler (severity: P1). Paging oncall.

marta (oncall): I'm on it. seeing enqueue rate spike ~4k reqs/min and pending queue > 3k. autoscaler reports 'quotaExceeded' on create requests.

sam (infra): confirming GCP API errors: 
```
ERROR: Compute API: quotaExceeded - 'Requested 'GPUS' resource exceeds the maximum per-project quota.'
```

marta (oncall): rough customer impact - increased latencies, ~18% 5xx rate for streaming endpoints, several customers flagged alerts.

elena (support): got two tenant escalations from SEs (acct: acme-inc, acct: org-mlkit). They want ETA. I'll draft comms but need timeline first.

raj (ml-runtime): quick mitigation options: fallback to smaller quantized model in us-west2 and route low-priority requests to CPU pool. But need routing toggle and model variant readiness.

sam (infra): checking quota view. Looks like project-level GPU quota in us-west1 hit hard after deployments earlier today. No auto-increase available — need cloud quota request with justification, but that takes hours.

infra-bot: warm-pool status: 0/4 warm nodes available in us-west1. Warm-pool failed to pre-claim due to quota at 03:12.

marta (oncall): immediate plan: 1) throttle non-prod and low-priority customers, 2) flip fallback routing to us-west2 for batch jobs, 3) enable CPU fallback for chat-lite endpoints, 4) open cloud support case and ask for expedited quota bump.

sam (infra): executing 1) and 2) now. applying temporary rate-limiter at the edge: `curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/v1/ratelimits -d '{"policy":"priority-based","low_priority_pct":0.2}'`

sam (infra): applied. low-priority traffic reduced ~65% at the edge within 20s. queue growth slowed but still >1.5k.

raj (ml-runtime): starting staged model switch for non-critical routes: `routeset update --region us-west2 --model redwood-small-quant-v1 --priority low`

marta (oncall): elena please notify customers: short note that we're mitigating with fallbacks; we'll provide ETA after vendor ticket.

elena (support): posting Slack thread in customer-facing channel + emailing SEs. Draft: "We're routing low-priority workloads to alternate region and enabling fallback models; core API still available but degraded. We'll follow up with timeline."

marta (oncall): cloud ticket opened: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/CASE-2026-9101 (case id CASE-2026-9101). Requested expedited GPU quota increase and temporary soft limit override.

infra-bot: GCP support auto-reply: "Case received. Target response 2 hours for expedited requests."

raj (ml-runtime): additional mitigation: reduce per-request concurrency and batch-size on the largest model to free up slots. Patch rolling: `PATCH /config/models/redwood-xxl -> {"batch_size":32 -> 16, "max_concurrency":8 -> 4}`. Doing canary on one nodegroup.

sam (infra): canary done. per-node throughput dropped but freed up ~12% pool capacity. Pending queue dropped to ~900.

marta (oncall): nice. still want fallback routing to other cloud if this stalls — repo of cross-cloud mapping: `infra/runbooks/region-fallback.md` has steps.

elena (support): customers asking about SLA — advising them we're under mitigation and will issue credit if degradation continues >2hrs.

marta (oncall): heads-up: if quota won't be increased quickly we'll need to enable emergency Dedicated capacity for impacted enterprise tenants (requires sales/finance approval). Raj, can you stand up the smaller dedicated endpoint?

raj (ml-runtime): yes, spinning up dedicated pool with quantized weights (cheap but CPU fallback for some models). provisioning command: `rctl dedicated create --region us-west1 --gpu-type t4 --count 2 --purpose emergency` — but this will also hit GPU quota. CPU-only option: `rctl dedicated create --region us-west1 --cpu-only --count 4`. Starting CPU-only now.

sam (infra): FYI cloud console shows some quota transiently freeing up from terminated preemptible jobs; we reclaimed ~1 GPU worth but it's fleeting.

marta (oncall): decided: no more GPU allocation in us-west1 until case resolved. Continue routing to us-west2/us-central1 and CPU fallbacks. Keep enforcing edge rate limit for low-priority.

infra-bot: routing update applied: `primary: us-west1(critical only) secondary: us-west2 (bulk)`

marta (oncall): monitoring metrics: total pending queue now 420, 5xxs steady at 6% (down from 18%). Latency p95 still elevated for critical flows but trending down.

elena (support): customers updated. SEs acknowledged and asked for ETA for full recovery.

sam (infra): GCP replied: "We can provision +10 GPUs to the project in 6-8 hours, expedite not guaranteed."

marta (oncall): acknowledge. timeline too long for some customers. Next actions: 1) continue cross-region routing, 2) keep batch reductions, 3) prepare offer for affected enterprise tenants to move to Dedicated or to increase commit, coordinate with sales, 4) follow up on permanent guardrail: increase warm-pool preclaim checking and pre-authorized quota request when expected deploys exceed X GPUs.

raj (ml-runtime): logging steps I took in runbook: `Runbook: adjust-batch -> reduced batch_size, concurrency; route non-critical; enable cpu-fallback; canary switched; monitor 15m`

marta (oncall): handing off to morning oncall at 07:00 UTC. please keep pager on for any regression.

sam (infra): adding checklist for handoff: current queue 410, edge limiter active, routes to us-west2 active, cloud case CASE-2026-9101, GCP expected +10 GPUs in ~6-8h.

elena (support): I'll keep liaising with SEs and prepare customer impact report with affected tenants, durations, and mitigation actions.

pagerduty-bot: Incident update: P1 -> monitoring. Handoff scheduled to next oncall.

marta (oncall): thanks team. logging post-incident notes now. We should add quota budget checks to pre-deploy CI and add a preflight alert when we push a model that would require >40% of a region's monthly quota.

sam (infra): posted infra action item: `ACTION-1234: add quota preflight + automated quota request pipeline`

raj (ml-runtime): and `ACTION-1235: build CPU-fallback smoke tests and make fallback the default for non-critical routes`

elena (support): will attach customer timelines to the postmortem.

marta (oncall): closing thread for now — handoff: next oncall please watch pending queue and vendor case.

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring.
